_comment: ContentDetect's optional image model (pushmpc/content_detect.h, filter/src/PushMpcContentModel.h): CLIP ViT-B/32's image encoder (OpenAI CLIP, MIT), ONNX export from the Xenova/clip-vit-base-patch32 repository (MIT) at a fixed commit. Fetched by Setup (scripts/content-model-fetch via anime-models-fetch.ps1), checked by size and SHA-256; a mismatch is refused. Without it, ContentDetect uses its hand-built cues only.
